tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the token identity, its scopes, and the remaining rate-limit budget. Call this first to verify the connection. No arguments.

tools.name: list_setups
tools.description: Return today's ranked stored setups with status and a compact trade plan or the reason it was skipped. Optional filters: status (tradeable, no_plan, in_portfolio, pending, blacklisted) and setup_type. This is the scanning answer; do not fetch price bars.

tools.name: get_trade_plan
tools.description: Return the trade plan for one ticker: entry, stop, 3R/5R targets, trailing hint, and instructions — or why there is no plan.

tools.name: get_portfolio
tools.description: Return the user's portfolio: pending, open, and closed positions with risk figures, compared with today's setups.

tools.name: get_watchlist
tools.description: Return the custom watchlist of the active scanner profile (or ?profile_id=...).

tools.name: update_watchlist
tools.description: Add, remove, or replace watchlist tickers (scope watchlist:write). Pass add / remove / replace; replace cannot be combined with add/remove. Send the same Idempotency-Key when retrying.
